name: PaiAgent
description: PaiAgent is an enterprise-level AI workflow visual orchestration platform for building, orchestrating, and executing AI workflows through a drag-and-drop interface. It combines a custom DAG workflow engine with LangGraph4j state-graph orchestration and Spring AI for unified multi-model access, driven by a React/ReactFlow visual editor. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
